name: My First Alchemy Set
summary: A young alchemist in Moonbrook asks you for basic supplies. She wants to begin learning despite her father's warning about herbs.

sections.title: A Young Alchemist
sections.body: The child in Moonbrook's barn has been told not to handle her father's herbs. She hopes to learn alchemy while she is still young, and asks you to bring her empty vials, Silverleaf, and Peacebloom. She is waiting to see what she can make with them.

faq.q: Who asks for the alchemy supplies?
faq.answer: A young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn in Moonbrook asks you for supplies.

faq.q: Why does she want these things?
faq.answer: She wants to start learning alchemy, but her father will not let her handle his herbs because he considers them dangerous.

faq.q: What supplies is she asking for?
faq.answer: She asks for five Empty Vials, five Silverleaf, and five Peacebloom.

faq.q: Where can I find the young alchemist?
faq.answer: She is inside the barn in Moonbrook, Westfall.

faq.q: What does she plan to do with the supplies?
faq.answer: She says she will see what she can make with the supplies.
